direct_answer.question: List Category wise highest priced product detail
direct_answer.answer: Across 5 product categories with 20 total products (4 per category), the highest priced products are: Electronics → iPhone 15 ($999.99), Beauty → Dyson Airwrap ($599.99), Home & Kitchen → Vitamix Blender ($449.99), Sports → Bowflex Dumbbells ($299.99), Apparel → Patagonia Fleece ($149.99). Electronics leads with the highest category maximum at $999.99, while Apparel has the lowest at $149.99.
direct_answer.why: Using RANK() window function partitioned by category and ordered by price descending, the rank-1 product per category was identified. Electronics' iPhone 15 commands the highest price at $999.99 — 6.7× more expensive than Apparel's top product. Beauty's Dyson Airwrap at $599.99 stands out as a premium outlier in its category, as it is 3× costlier than the next product in that category (La Mer Cream at $195). Sports shows the widest price gap proportionally — Bowflex Dumbbells at $299.99 vs. the cheapest item (Camelbak at $29.99), a 10× spread.
direct_answer.approach: Queried the gold_category_highest_priced_product table using a CTE with RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price_diff_from_category_max DESC) to identify the single highest-priced product per category. A second query computed pct_of_category_max and products_in_category for full category breakdown and comparative analysis.

detailed_analysis:
The Gold table contains 20 products evenly distributed across 5 categories (4 products each). The category-wise highest priced products reveal a clear pricing hierarchy: Electronics leads at $999.99 (iPhone 15), followed by Beauty at $599.99 (Dyson Airwrap), Home & Kitchen at $449.99 (Vitamix Blender), Sports at $299.99 (Bowflex Dumbbells), and Apparel at $149.99 (Patagonia Fleece). Notably, Electronics has a healthy competitive spread — Samsung Galaxy S24 at $849.99 is 85% of the max — whereas Beauty shows extreme price polarisation: the Dyson Airwrap at $599.99 is followed by La Mer Cream at only $195 (32.5% of max), with Cerave and Neutrogena at $16.99 and $12.99 respectively, making the Airwrap nearly 46× more expensive than the cheapest item in its category.

Sports demonstrates the starkest intra-category spread in relative terms: the Bowflex Dumbbells top the category at $299.99, while the Camelbak Water Bottle sits at just $29.99 — a 10× ratio and only 10% of the category max. Home & Kitchen shows the most balanced distribution with Vitamix Blender ($449.99), KitchenAid Mixer ($349.99, 77.8%), Nespresso Machine ($199.99, 44.4%), and Instant Pot Duo ($89.99, 20%). Apparel is also relatively balanced with Nike Air Max at 80% of the Patagonia Fleece max.

From a business strategy standpoint, Electronics and Beauty represent premium pricing opportunities — the highest absolute prices in those categories indicate customers are willing to pay a significant premium for flagship technology and luxury personal care products. Retailers should ensure these high-value items (iPhone 15, Dyson Airwrap, Vitamix Blender) are prominently featured in marketing campaigns, as they serve as category anchors that elevate the perceived value of the entire product range.
